queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT corpeventprx,
       avg_anlycount,
       avg_gap,
       avg_gap - (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM g) AS gap_minus_mean_gap
FROM g;
SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx);
SELECT sentreg, instownpct - inholdpct AS gap
FROM sentimentandfundamentals
ORDER BY gap DESC;
SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS plain_avg_of_avg_gaps
FROM (
  SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(ABS(newsscore - socscore)) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
);
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(infoleaksc) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT (SELECT a FROM g WHERE corpeventprx IS NULL) - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM g WHERE corpeventprx IN ('Earnings','Restructuring','M&A')) AS gap;
